label: Trenton Merricks, Précis of Truth and…: If x makes proposition p true, then necessarily, if both x…
locator: PDF p. 1, partial account of making true
interpretation: The existence of the proposition as well as that of the maker guards the necessary conditional. No world-immanence condition or sufficient definition of truthmaking is added.
attribution: The passage states that making true requires the necessary conditional guarded by existence of both entity and proposition, which is the premise.
